about: memory.mts --budgets for the low-memory setup (?lowmem=1&geofree=1&farimp=1, the whole island) on SwiftShader: one practice match, sampled at the playable title, as the plane phase starts, and on foot 60 s after the play phase starts. CI's no-GPU low-memory memory job runs it. A number over its budget fails; a number more than underPct under fails until the budget is lowered (the failure names the new value, measured plus headroomPct), so budgets only go down. residentPois counts the built POI modules, the lobby islet included; peakResidentPois is the most there were at once (polled every 250 ms), so it is the cap (lowmemcap 3) plus the islet and fails both ways if the cap stops holding or nothing streams; evictions counts POIs evicted so far. In the plane only WebGL bytes, textures and the JS heap are budgeted: which POI is mid-build when the plane phase starts varies, and CPU copies moved 204.9-255.6 MB (geometry) and 313.9-392.4 MB (textures) between the runs. Set 2026-11-07 from three runs on the CI runner (job 'no-GPU low-memory memory', run 42331517673, branch head b62ff65 on main 4548a29). Title: WebGL 1312.6-1323.3 MB, textures 243-244, geometry CPU 118.9-119.9 MB, texture CPU 268.6 MB, JS heap 179.0-179.2 MB. Plane: WebGL 2066.3-2073.4 MB, textures 500, JS heap 209.2-211.2 MB. Match: WebGL 2144.7-2146.3 MB, textures 493, geometry CPU 319.2-319.8 MB, texture CPU 249.9 MB, JS heap 221.7-222.8 MB, 4 resident POIs (peak 4), 1 eviction. Each MB and texture budget is the largest of the three plus 2%, rounded up; the POI counts and evictions are the measured value, exactly.
